name: Haiku deep value
strategy: Tech-led tactical rotation with energy momentum positioning and elevated cash ahead of Fed rate decision
reassessment_note: Previous rotation thesis backfired due to fundamental miscall on tech momentum: TQQQ short down -19.49% as Nasdaq rallied 24.99% in September (+12.8% TQQQ, +9.68% October). Reversing directional conviction. Elevated cash to 50% ahead of October 28 Fed decision (markets expect hold, but data-dependent). QQQ 18% captures structural tech strength with disciplined risk management via 12% stop. Energy positioning maintained as oil breaks $100/barrel on geopolitical tensions. Financial sector holding ahead of rate stability. All positions now include stop-loss and take-profit levels for capital preservation and systematic profit-taking.

positions.thesis: Nasdaq-100 momentum confirmed: +24.99% in September, TQQQ +12.8%, driven by earnings revisions on Nvidia, Microsoft, Broadcom. Reversing previous short conviction. Discipline via 12% stop protects against reversal below 2026-10-05 entry; 25% take-profit locks gains at $1,250 profit on 18% allocation.

Emerging markets momentum established (+2.97% from 2026-09-16 entry). Positioning for year-end rally as Fed holds rates steady and China stabilizes. iShares MSCI Emerging Markets breadth supports sustainable upside.

Energy sector structural setup: Brent crude >$100/barrel on geopolitical tensions (first time since July 2026), XLE up 9% in 30 days, 40% portfolio weight in XOM and CVX provides stability. Rate hold environment supportive for dividend yields.

Financials defensively positioned: Fed expected to hold rates in October, December hike possible keeps yield curve stable. XLF down -4.02% from 2026-09-16 entry provides entry opportunity; stops protect downside if recession signals emerge.

Bitcoin momentum intact: +32% from entry, trading $84,600 range in early October. Geopolitical backdrop and Fed hold support risk-on positioning. 4% allocation balances conviction with discipline; 15% stop-loss caps crypto drawdown risk.
